name: Replica Dialogue Timing
description: Deterministically compare server-probed target speech durations with original dialogue slots and publish a reviewed timing plan without rewriting script or storyboard.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT TARGET_SCRIPT and human-accepted CURRENT TARGET_AUDIO
when_not_to_use: Target audio is only a candidate

steps.title: 校验对白与音频 lineage
steps.description: 逐句核对 utterance、Final Target Dialogue hash 与真实音频覆盖。

steps.title: 计算对白时序
steps.description: 以原 Source slot 和真实语音时长计算 residual hold / overflow；不调用外部 Provider。

fact_levels: Source dialogue slot comes from TARGET_SCRIPT lineage
Actual speech duration comes from TARGET_AUDIO
provider_rules: This skill is deterministic and must not create ProviderJob
Do not rewrite script, compress audio, stretch shots, or invent visual slack
completion_criteria: Every target audio clip matches one target script utterance
Timing math is exact in integer microseconds
No unresolved overflow exists before formal publication
failure_policy: Any overflow blocks formal TIMING_PLAN acceptance
Previous CURRENT remains unchanged on rejection/failure
